## Problem and root cause

Ticket IDs, confirmed trigger, user impact, and the regression reproduced before the fix.

## Change and alternatives

Resulting behavior, important decisions, and any simpler alternative rejected.

## Compatibility

Document schema/readers, public API, host/plugin impact, and named source commits compared.

## Verification

Exact commands/results, failing-before/passing-after evidence, and unverified gates.

## Security, accessibility and design

Relevant trust boundaries, keyboard/RTL impact, and screenshots for meaningful UI changes.

## Rollback

Safe revert/recovery procedure and any remaining compatibility constraints.

## Sign-off

Technical reviewer, host/schema owner when applicable, product/design/accessibility/security acceptance, and release owner if shipping.
